request.text:
1. 치지직 녹화목록에서, 어떤건 다른거 위로 오버레이해서 펼쳐지고 어떤건 밀어내면서 펼쳐지는데 이거 고쳐줘. 그리고 전체적으로 녹화목록 각 박스가 접었을때 기준으로, 너무 삐뚤빼뚤해.
2. X의 북마크와 마음함보는 방법을 지금 처럼 유지하는게 1옵션, 그리고 미디어나 글을 기준으로 카드형식으로 보는게 2옵션으로 선택할 수 있게 해줘. 카드형식 UI의 구성방식은 히토미의 요약보기 방식을 참고해줘

requirements: CHZZK single-file and multi-file broadcast disclosures use the same non-reflow overlay; collapsed summaries have equal profile/title/metadata/status slots. Preserve recorded media, ongoing processing, context menu and selection.

X likes/bookmarks default to unchanged official web display. Offer persisted default/card view and post/media card basis only on those collections. Retain sessions, native right preview and account isolation.

Cards reference Hitomi compact covers with readable bottom caption. Text-only posts remain visible in post mode; media mode uses individual observed media. No likes/bookmarks/account actions sent for tests.

Use currently rendered official collection data without private API or a new authentication flow. Bounded progressive loading with loading/error/retry state, same-source observed media URLs only, no fabricated empty success.
Preserve privacy, navigation, source ordering, original list scroll on view return, main sidebar footer positions and >=14px typography.
decisions: Latest request removes single-file in-flow expansion exception. Existing saved expansion preferences retained; opening any group foregrounds that overlay.
Card clicks open validated native preview paths; media cards target observed photo/video route. Standard mode leaves official interaction unchanged.
Nov10 actual Computer Use authorized. Correct only redundant feed-wrapper clipping with CSS HMR; preserve the existing app process, sessions, recordings and postprocessing.
acceptance: Single/multiple expanded groups never move neighbors; titles/status lengths do not change collapsed dimensions at 1280x720/1920x1080.
View choices persist independently for likes/bookmarks; late commands fenced by generation/feed; switching doesn't reset preview/feed document.
Text/media cards, original ordering, deduplication, lazy loading/pagination/retry, account switch/privacy clearing, source URL validation and preview path behavior covered.
Typecheck, frontend tests and isolated browser layout; native compile/tests. Actual authenticated desktop acceptance separately reported if unavailable.

implementation.actualAppAcceptance: verified on the current authenticated debug app for the requested recording layout and X collection browsing flows
implementation.bgd: host not alive; agent not reachable
liveChecks: single/multiple recording overlay and equal collapsed cards
card to right preview and preview preservation
original scroll restoration and additional likes loading
automatedOnly: account switching/privacy reset and generation isolation

followup.text: 지금 뭔가 잘 안됐는데 컴퓨터 사용해서 검토 후 끝까지 마무리 해줘.

supersededDecisions.decision: Live installed release remains running during source edits; no recorder/download cancellation; main-desktop input remains deferred pending direction.
supersededDecisions.reason: The Nov10 follow-up explicitly resumed main-desktop Computer Use. The current debug app was already running; its active postprocessing was preserved.
